recipe.name: High-Protein Chicken and Beef Cottage Cheese Meatballs

yield.note: Estimate at ~2 oz per meatball. Actual count depends on your scoop size — weigh or count and recalculate macros by weight if needed.

wet.note: 90-93% lean is ideal; 99% lean will be dry
One 16 oz tub. This is a lot of moisture — see panko note.

dry.item: pre-shredded Mexican blend or cheddar jack
seasoning blend (carne asada, taco, or DIY)

dry.note: Start with 1 1/2 cups. Add the remaining 1/2 cup only if the mix is still too wet to hold together — do not dump both cups in at once.
Go light — seasoning, cottage cheese, and cheese are all salty

steps: Preheat oven to 400F. Line two sheet pans with parchment.
Mix chicken, beef, eggs, cottage cheese, shredded cheese, and seasoning until just combined. Do not overwork it.
Add 1 1/2 cups panko. Mix until just combined. Squeeze a handful — if it holds together, stop. If it is wet and slumping, add the remaining panko 1/4 cup at a time.
If the mix feels loose, chill 15-20 minutes before scooping.
Scoop into meatballs across the two pans. Aim for about 2 oz each for roughly 24 meatballs.
Bake 20-25 minutes until internal temp reaches 165F. Rotate pans halfway through.
recipe.storage: Fridge up to 4 days in an airtight container. Freeze up to 3 months — freeze on a sheet pan first, then bag so they don't stick.
recipe.reheat: From frozen: oven 350F for 15-20 min. From thawed: skillet over medium heat 4-5 min, turning once. Also good cold.

macrosPerMeatball.notes: At 24 meatballs (~2 oz each) with 2 cups panko. At 1 1/2 cups panko: ~150 cal, 15g protein, 3.5g carbs, 8g fat. Macros scale linearly by weight — weigh a meatball if your scoop differs.

macrosPerServing.notes: 4 meatballs per serving at 2 oz each.

recipe.notes: 2 cups of cottage cheese for 3 lbs of meat is wetter than the original 2-lb recipe — panko is the binder and is not optional in this version. Panko range is 1 1/2 to 2 cups, added in stages. Mix stays soft; chill if loose before scooping. Doubles to 6 lbs meat with a third sheet pan.
